name: research
description: Fetch 2-4 authoritative sources via relay, extract facts
instructions:
Use fetch (relay@1.0) to retrieve:
- Microsoft Project Natick (water)
- Nautilus / offshore floating datacenters
- Kepler / Starcloud / space datacenter concepts
Extract: power, cooling, latency, failure mode, cost. Keep quotes + URLs. Do not invent.

name: summarize
description: Take documents, extract key points, produce tight brief
instructions: Given research docs, produce 10 bullets: 5 water, 5 space. Each bullet: claim + source URL.

name: write_essay
description: Write 800w essay: water vs space datacenters
instructions:
Write essay using identity.md/user.md/soul.md + memory:
H1: Datacenters in Water and Space
H2: Water (Natick) — cooling, deployment, biofouling
H2: Space (solar, radiation, launch $)
Table: Power | Cooling | Latency | Repair | Cost
Conclusion: boring tradeoffs, not hype. Cite sources footnotes.

name: research-write
instructions: Compose research then summarize then write_essay. First fetch sources, then bullet brief, then 800w essay.
